notes: Route: permissive robots.txt (200, 'Allow: /', Sitemap: https://vreme.com/sitemaps.xml). Tried the Yoast sitemap index -> post-sitemap1.xml, but Yoast post-sitemap <lastmod> is edit time (per g4media-ro/nannews-ng notes in this grid), so it is unusable as the listed date. Final route: WordPress REST API https://vreme.com/wp-json/wp/v2/posts?per_page=100&_fields=date,link&page=N, newest-first, 9 pages/status 200 covering 2026-10-26 back through 2026-09-26, filter date part of REST 'date' (Belgrade local) to 2026-09-25..2026-10-25. Verified 'date' == page JSON-LD datePublished to the second (REST 2026-10-26T07:49:10 local vs page +01:00 after the 2026-10-25 DST fall-back; date_gmt is UTC and would drift a day for early-morning posts, so local 'date' is the right one). Output: 820 unique URLs, 31/31 days, min 13 (2026-10-04), check days 2026-09-30=47, 2026-10-10=17, 2026-10-20=21. Self-test: 4 sample re-fetches all 200 with page datePublished diff 0 days and 5393-9584 visible text chars. Runtime ~7s, ~10 requests, well under 20 min.
